caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional sculpture of an eagle with its wings outstretched. The eagle sits upright, with its head turned slightly to its left. The wings are extended horizontally to either side of the body, showing detailed feather textures. Both talons are visible and rest on a rounded base that suggests rock or earth. The eagle's body includes detailed features such as feathered tufts on the chest and legs. The color palette is grayscale, with black, gray, and white tones used for shading and texture, giving the drawing a realistic, monochromatic appearance. The background is a plain, light-colored surface, providing contrast and focusing attention on the central sculptural figure. There is a small, indistinct signature or text in the bottom left corner.
